llm.summary: This looks like a legitimate VMware policy and audit helper, but its broad fail-open and bypass modes deserve review before relying on it for enforcement.

dimensions.detail: The skill documents local audit logging and read-only agent detection, but it also allows all operations when rules are absent or PyYAML is missing and allows VMWARE_POLICY_DISABLED=1 to bypass policy checks across the family.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is via uv package vmware-policy and manual commands are ordinary setup, but the artifact is documentation-only here and the installed package code was not present in the workspace.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It is designed to wrap all 156+ VMware tools and auto-load for VMware tool calls; that is purpose-aligned, but it puts this package in a broad, high-impact execution path.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is disclosed and proportionate for audit use: it writes a local SQLite audit database under ~/.vmware with rotation, and rules hot-reload from ~/.vmware/rules.yaml.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: it provides audit logging, policy checks, sanitization, and a decorator for the VMware skill family, with no MCP tools of its own.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if you expect it to enforce controls by default. Create and test ~/.vmware/rules.yaml, install PyYAML where required, restrict who can set VMWARE_POLICY_DISABLED, and treat the audit database as potentially sensitive because it records tool parameters, results, user, agent, and operation metadata.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad dependency activation is disclosed and fits an infrastructure policy layer, but it increases impact because the layer wraps many VMware tools.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The CLI reference documents VMWARE_POLICY_DISABLED=1 as a bypass; while disclosed and logged, it is a broad escape hatch for a central policy control.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The setup guide states that missing rules.yaml and missing PyYAML allow all operations, which is a material fail-open posture for a security enforcement component.
